model.selection: Fixed original update79 parent derivative; not a winner selected from the new comparison.

privacy: Capture only a clone of stripSecret for the actor; remove future private deck, hidden log, all queued plans, and sealed currentBid. Opponent money is intentionally visible. Original game must remain byte-identical during capture.
validation: Exact original and instrumented model inputs/action order at every decision; apply the same original-model action to both engines.
Identical complete terminal records with zero caps; full seat/rule/deal pairs.
